title: Target-population construction for G5 and the L7 half of G6

specification_status.statement: The repository contains no Phase G specification and no gate number. PHASE-F.md cites 'master-guide §21.1' for a target slice with both correctness classes, but that guide is not in this repository. Phase G therefore implements only the documented prerequisite and defines no new gate, threshold, or acceptance table. Any numeric gate for Phase G requires an approved specification first.
documented_sources: PHASE-E.md §7.4 - build a target population containing both classes before claiming target-slice AUROC or the complete G5 criterion
PHASE-E.md structural G5 finding - a slice with both correctness classes on which the detector both fires and stays silent
PHASE-F.md §12.1 - build a target slice with both correctness classes so the L7 stratum is evaluable

audit.note: read-only; the detector fields come from Phase D and the scores from Phase E, both stored in this run

screen.expectation_note: 24 items x 10 samples is the size of the Phase A pilot (scripts/06_pilot.py), which is the project's own precedent for a go/no-go screen

yield_planning.note: PLANNING parameters for a cost estimate, not gates. They are passed explicitly to jurisuq.target.items_needed so the assumption is visible in the report.
yield_planning.basis: a usable two-class evaluation population needs enough correct items for an AUROC interval to be meaningful; 15 is the planning floor used for the Phase G cost estimate and is NOT a threshold from the engineering guide

forbidden_operations.note: recorded so a future run cannot quietly violate them
